item.summary: This research entry examines the WAKE✳︎ architectural boundary as defined in `docs/architecture.md`. WAKE operates through a strictly governed cycle of Record, Context, Proposal, Governance, Transition, and Receipt. The system ensures that model-generated suggestions remain advisory—never authoritative—by separating the persistent database from the ephemeral model execution environment. This structure supports the continuity of research work independent of the specific model instance, providing a verifiable trace of governance-approved state transitions. The self-study confirms that the agent's role is to propose research actions within this durable framework, rather than attempting to alter the underlying system governance or execute external operations.
item.title: WAKE✳︎ Self-Study: Architectural Authority and Continuity
